title: YOELEO gravel frame engineering article recheck
notes: Manufacturer article describes G21 targeted bottom-bracket/head-tube stiffness and reports 100,000 cycles at 1,100 N, 50,000 vertical cycles at 1,200 N, and a 22.5 kg impact drop. These are manufacturer design/durability protocols, not numeric deflection results or independent comparative stiffness tests.
